tr: Sıra sende: 'Erken çıkıyorum, zamanında varalım diye.' —
en: Your turn: 'I am leaving early so that we arrive on time.' — finish it with

tr: Bir de zıddı: 'Dinlenebilmem için tatile ihtiyacım var.' —
en: And the other way round: 'I need a holiday so that I can rest.' —

tr: Son bir tane: 'Herkes iyi olsun diye çalışıyorum.' —
en: One last one: 'I work so that everyone is well.' —
Last one: 'I switched my phone on to ring you.' —
(a separable verb!)
It means 'although'. As a subclause:

tr: Yan cümle önde olunca ana cümle fiille başlar: gehe ich.
en: With the clause first the main clause starts with the verb: gehe ich.

tr: Sıra sende: 'Maaş iyi olmasına rağmen istifa ediyorum.' —
en: Your turn: 'Although the pay is good I am resigning.' —

tr: 'yine de' demek. Ana cümle zarfı: birinci sırayı kaplar, fiil ikinci, özne üçüncü.
en: 'all the same'. An adverb of the main clause: it takes first place, the verb second, the subject third.
Now build the same sentence with trotzdem:

tr: geçmişte tek seferlik olay ya da dönem:
en: a one-off event or period in the past:
Childhood is a single period → als.
Your turn: 'When I came to Germany I was 20.' —
a repeated event or the future:
Every time → wenn.

tr: Yeni zaman: Plusquamperfekt — hatte/war + Partizip II.
en: A new tense: the Plusquamperfekt — hatte/war + Partizip II.
The English 'after I had …' is what this is. The words first.

tr: Yan cümlede Plusquamperfekt (hatte/war + Partizip), ana cümlede Präteritum ya da Perfekt. Hareket fiillerinde war:
en: The subclause in the Plusquamperfekt (hatte/war + Partizip), the main clause in the Präteritum or the Perfekt. With verbs of movement war:
Your turn: 'I applied after I had finished my training.' —
'After I got the acceptance I moved.' —
Last: 'After I had arrived I rang my family.' —
(motion → war)

tr: İkisi de yan cümle bağlacı: fiil sona. Türkçeden fark, olumsuzlukta: 'gitmeden önce' Almancada olumlu
en: Both are subclause conjunctions: the verb goes last. English is the same on the negative: 'before I go' carries no 'not', and neither does
— no nicht is added. The words first.
'before'.
Careful: there is NO nicht in a bevor clause.
Your turn: 'Before I leave I lock the door.' —
(abschließen)
'-while': two events at once.
The verb last again.
Your turn: 'We chat during the break.' — instead of
the more natural one is:
, but let us build a clause:
'that is why'.

tr: deshalb birinci sırada, habe ikinci, ich üçüncü.
en: deshalb in first place, habe second, ich third.

tr: Sıra sende: 'Teklif kötüydü, bu yüzden reddettim.' —
en: Your turn: 'The offer was bad, so I turned it down.' —
Its opposite is trotzdem: the reverse of what was expected.
The same order.

tr: Sıra sende: 'Yorgundum, yine de spora gittim.' —
en: Your turn: 'I was tired, but I went to sport anyway.' —

tr: Son: aynı fikri denn ile — 'Geç kaldım, çünkü trafik vardı.' —
en: Last one: the same idea with denn — 'I was late, because there was traffic.' —
(the order does not change!)

tr: — je yarısında fiil sonda (übe), desto yarısında fiil özneden önce (werde ich).
en: — in the je half the verb is last (übe), in the desto half the verb comes before the subject (werde ich).

tr: Sıra sende: 'Ne kadar çok okursam kelime hazinem o kadar büyük olur.' —
en: Your turn: 'The more I read the bigger my vocabulary is.' —
(groß → größer)

tr: 'Ne kadar çok deneyimim olursa o kadar özgüvenli olurum.' —
en: 'The more experience I have the more confident I am.' —
'either … or'.
'both … and'.
The third one:
'neither … nor':
— NO nicht.

tr: Son: 'Ne vaktim ne de param var.' —
en: Last: 'I have neither time nor money.' —
'I was on the phone a long time, so I missed the train.' —
My aim is not to make you like it but to make you CRACK it:

tr: bir söz değil, bir erteleme. C1'de bunu duymak da kurmak da gerekiyor. Önce kelimeler.
en: is not a promise, it is a postponement. At C1 you have to hear this and to build it. The words first.

tr: Sahte özne 'es' burada çok işine yarar:
en: The dummy subject 'es' is very useful here:

tr: — alışveriş yapılması gerekiyor, kim yapacak henüz belli değil. Önce kelimeler.
en: — the shopping still has to be done, and who will do it is not yet settled. The words first.
